lesson: Diagnostic run (read-only) after review round 3 found three more items that ship with lesson 92's fixes; the contract is unchanged, only the ORDER of two existing rules. (4) human-decision-scope.ts deriveNativeWriteScope returns undefined (which the caller turns into the full-hash Allow key) when file_path or path is a non-string, BEFORE boundary-checking the string destination that IS present; so { file_path: 'settings.yaml', path: 1 } is remembered as a full-hash Allow instead of refusing protected_destination. Fix: boundary-check every supplied non-blank string destination FIRST (any outside ⇒ refused protected_destination), and only then apply the malformed-shape rule (⇒ undefined ⇒ full hash, as the contract says). Add the mixed malformed-plus-protected case to human-decision-scope.test.ts. (5) deriveVirtualWriteScope likewise returns undefined for a malformed companion field before checking whether an available string path (write path, promote_scratch targetPath) is a protected virtual entry via isProtectedArtifactEntry; check protection of every available string destination (and protected: true) before the malformed fallback; add the case. (6) human-decision-memory-service.test.ts:139 defines request twice in one fixture literal (the second at :146 silently wins) — remove the first. Everything else stays as lesson 92 says; no new enum member, no wrapper, no rename.
